all_tweets.text:
I talk to 50+ Web3 candidates a week.
The ones who never get hired all make the same mistake:
They list "Solidity" on their resume but can't explain how a reentrancy attack works in the interview.
Web3 hiring is brutal right now. Companies don't want buzzword stackers. They want builders who've shipped something — even a weekend hackathon project counts more than a Udemy cert.
If you're trying to break into crypto, build one thing. Deploy it. Put the GitHub link in your bio. That's it.
